decisions.reason: As a full sports flooring system built on the established offer, it likely involved meaningful development and sales commitment, so management is inclined to continue despite its weaker fit with the style-led interior direction.
A mobile arena floor system is a resource-intensive extension of the existing business, and sunk investment plus the public launch make management relatively likely to persist with it.
Because this arena floor system also builds on established capabilities and was visibly introduced, management has incentives to justify the earlier commitment by keeping it on the market.
The chevron parquet is close to the core range, was prominent on the home page, and fits the firm's announced move toward trend-led natural interior flooring, so it is very likely to be retained.
This squash-court surface finish is a narrower, more peripheral item with less visible strategic importance, making it easier for management to discontinue once results are not clearly temporary.
Oak skirting for sports floors is a lower-commitment accessory rather than a flagship system, so management can drop it with relatively little loss or need for justification.
